application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.source: device-reported battery_technology field in the released tables

units_released.note: Rule: one file per device. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: one released cell_id telemetry table per device parquet
cells_liion.note: Assumes one cell per device (the data paper says most devices have a single cell); one cell_id per file measured.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.source: one voltage_cell channel per released device parquet

energy_mwh.note: Sum over 33 devices of nominal_capacity (Ah, data paper p. 4) times median cell voltage; for 10 devices without a usable nominal_capacity (7 report 0 and 3 leave it empty), the charge counter near full charge is used.

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from the released data

span_unit_years.note: The held archive is the portal export Dataset_from_Mobile_Battery_Data_Explorer_2026-04.zip, not the section under 10.18154/RWTH-2025-00754: it includes 214,351 rows from 5 devices before the paper's 2026-01-14 start and ends 2026-03-31 (3.09 device-years without those rows).

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://publications.rwth-aachen.de/record/1002905; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
sentinels_documented.note: current_avg = -2147.483648 (Integer.MIN_VALUE x 1e-6) on every row of 10 devices, observed, masked by clean=True; nominal_capacity 0 on 7 devices, left as released (source audit 2026-10-04).
